parameters.formDescription: Produce a set of visual assets from one source text.

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { SPEC: j.SPEC, SPEC_JSON: j.SPEC_JSON } }];

nodes.name: render_video
nodes.notes: A failed render must not block the other assets, so the error is continued and video_result turns the missing binary into that asset's ERROR. See video_result.notes and the 'continueRegularOutput makes a failure invisible' rule in AGENTS.md.

nodes.name: video_result
nodes.notes: Handles render_video's continued error: no binary means that asset carries ERROR and the run continues, which is what makes the failure visible instead of silent.

nodes.name: execute_author
nodes.notes: A failed or unconfigured authoring call must not block the other assets, so the error is continued and agent_result turns the missing binary into that asset's ERROR. See agent_result.notes and the 'continueRegularOutput makes a failure invisible' rule in AGENTS.md.

nodes.name: fetch_artifact
nodes.notes: The artifact the session served; continued on error for the same reason as execute_author, and agent_result reports it as this asset's ERROR.
